digest.component_or_area: outbound reconciliation differ and field comparison
propositions: The outbound differ compares in vendor (Jira) shape while the inbound differ canonicalizes via InboundMapper before comparing, creating asymmetry that violates ADR 0035 §(d)
Field comparison helpers (_diff_fields, _extract_jira_field, _assignee_matches) reside in core but consume vendor-nested dict keys, forcing the Backend port to publish raw Jira snapshot dicts

The outbound update path must canonicalize the snapshot entry via the injected InboundMapper (mirroring inbound differ), then diff and emit in local vocabulary, crossing core boundaries only as opaque vendor payloads
Three new canonical output keys are needed from InboundMapper—assignee_identity, remote_parent_id, reporter_identity—each with fixed shape and presence-guarded to tolerate partial baseline dicts

Emission-boundary mapping via new OutboundMapper.map_fields_to_remote(changed_local_fields) translates only the changed field subset back to vendor shape, preserving the assignee resolver contract and _assignee_is_account_id sentinel

Decision equivalence must hold across all status/priority/assignee/parent/description/label/baseline/inbound-directionality comparison paths after canonicalization, verified by characterization suite against today's behavior
